lines.speaker: Yeden
lines.text: You're Kelsier's apprentice. Tell him I'm tired of drilling in the dark while the Final Empire drinks our blood up there.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Ham says they need more time.

lines.speaker: Yeden
lines.text: Ham is a thief who likes to fight. I've been leading skaa rebels since before he could lift a practice sword. The garrison is thin right now. Thinner than it will ever be again.

lines.speaker: Yeden
lines.text: Opportunities don't wait for thieves to finish their planning. Remember that I said so.
